Subject: Budget range validation - Acme Payments (post-demo)

Hi Bethany / Tom -

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can put together a tailored price/PO-ready quote: 

- High-level usage signals you shared: ~40M tokens/month across customer-facing chat, spiking to ~80M in peak months.
- Primary requirement: sub-250ms p95 on chat flows; occasional long-form generation for reports (avg seq len ~1k tokens)
- Procurement note you mentioned: vendor selection needs a PO threshold and legal review for anything >$50k quarterly.

Two asks to validate so our quote matches procurement and unit economics: 
1) Confirm the monthly spend band you expect - is the steady-state 30-50M tokens/month with occasional peaks to 70-80M? If you have an internal target $/1M tokens (or target total monthly budget) that helps a ton.
2) Any required procurement thresholds or preferred billing cadence (monthly vs quarterly invoicing / PO)?

I'm attaching a rough pricing breakdown that maps Redwood unit economics to your volumes (ballpark $/1M tokens at different configs) - see pricing-breakdown.xlsx. If the band above looks right I'll send a formal quote and draft SOW for procurement.

Next steps: if you confirm volumes/budget band we can get a formal quote + SOW over to your procurement team by Friday. Happy to jump on a 20-min call with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
[Attachment: pricing-breakdown.xlsx]

From: Bethany Cole <bethany@acme-payments.com>

Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - Acme Payments (post-demo)

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the follow-up and the deck. Confirming rough numbers from our side:
- Baseline: ~35M tokens/month (customer chat + light NLU processing)
- Growth/peak months: ~70-80M tokens/month (marketing pushes / holiday season)
- Long-form reports are infrequent - maybe ~5-10% of tokens but higher seq length.

Budget guidance: our product team is aiming for ~$1,000-\u2013$1,500 per 1M tokens (all-in) as a target for vendor selection - that maps to an expected monthly spend of $35k-\u2013$52.5k in baseline months. Procurement: anything over $50k/month gets routed to the VP of Finance and requires a formal SOW + PO. Preferred billing cadence is monthly, but we can do quarterly invoicing if that simplifies PO processing.

If you can provide an example quote that shows unit price tiers (e.g., 0-25M, 25-75M, 75M+) and expected SLA for latency, that will help speed procurement.

Best,
Bethany Cole
Head of Product | Acme Payments
bethany@acme-payments.com

Hi Bethany -

This is super helpful, thanks. Confirmation on a few points so procurement gets what they need: 
- We'll produce a quote that maps to the bands you requested. Preliminary (ballpark) pricing we'll show for discussion: 
  - 0-25M tokens: $1,600 / 1M tokens
  - 25-75M tokens: $1,200 / 1M tokens
  - 75M+ tokens: $900 / 1M tokens
These are illustrative - final price will depend on model choice (open-vs-Redwood-verified), latency SLOs, and any required private deployment/Dedicated options.

- For your stated target $1k-\u2013$1.5k / 1M tokens, the 25-75M band maps closest to $1.2k / 1M as a starting negotiation point. On a 35M baseline month that's ~$42k/month.

- We'll include monthly invoicing as the default, and add a line in the SOW for PO routing over $50k/month plus a named SLAs section.

Attachments: I'll send a formal quote + an SOW draft to procurement by tomorrow. In the meantime, attached is a short one-pager that breaks down latency tradeoffs and recommended model/quantization options for cost savings.

Would you like us to include a sample PO-ready SOW with redlines for your legal team? We can also do a 20-min procurement intro call next week (I can bring our contracts lead).

Thanks -
Marissa
